hook: Wish you had more control over the AI bots crawling your website?
body: Cloudflare just rolled out powerful new options for managing AI traffic. You can now granularly differentiate between AI bots for search, general agents, and those training models. This gives site owners unprecedented control, letting you protect your content, intellectual property, and vital ad-monetized pages from unwanted scraping.
